notes.title: The future of United Assault
notes.content:
Dear United Assault Community,

We hope this message finds you well and enjoying your experiences in the battles of Normandy '44, the Battle of the Bulge, and the broader theater of World War II in our United Assault series. As developers, we've been deeply grateful for the overwhelming support and enthusiasm you've shown for our games.

However, as much as we've cherished your feedback and excitement, we must address some challenges we've encountered along the way. When we embarked on the journey of creating United Assault - Normandy '44, we never anticipated the immense success it would become. Initially targeting the Nintendo Switch, the game's unexpected popularity brought with it both joy and unforeseen technical hurdles.

As we've continued to support and improve our games, we've encountered limitations in their structure and performance that, regrettably, cannot be easily overcome without significant restructuring. The prospect of rewriting the entire game is daunting, not only from a technical standpoint but also considering the potential impact on the experience you've come to love.

That's why we're reaching out to you, our valued community, for your input and guidance. We're considering the possibility of United Assault 2, a fresh start that would allow us to address the shortcomings of the original games while staying true to the spirit of the series. But we don't want to embark on this journey without your voices being heard.

[b][h2][url=https://forms.gle/duSYNE9AcxHYTq2v6]Share Your Voice: Take Our United Assault 2 Survey Now![/url][/h2][/b]

-> [url=https://forms.gle/duSYNE9AcxHYTq2v6]https://forms.gle/duSYNE9AcxHYTq2v6[/url]

Would you be interested in a United Assault 2? If so, what settings, features, and directions would you like to see explored? We want to involve you from the very beginning, offering open access to early development builds and fostering a collaborative relationship throughout the process.

We also want to take this opportunity to express our sincerest apologies for any lingering issues you may have encountered in the original games. Your support means everything to us, and we're committed to delivering the best possible experience for our community, both now and in the future.

[b]Thank you for your continued passion and dedication. Together, let's shape the future of United Assault.[/b]

notes.title: Road To Tobruk
notes.content:
[b][h2]United Assault - World War 2 is now available![/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213481/d79547874f6ca227d0e22b1d5d84381fdbd900c1.jpg[/img]

United Assault - World War 2 launched in Early Access and we are working hard on the first content update - Tobruk.

The current plan is to release update v0.2.5 in a preview next week. This preview will contain an unfinished Tobruk Map and several new party unfinished weapons. This will give you the chance to play the new map early and provide feedback for the regular update releasing shortly afterwards.

We also listened to your feedback and are improving the existing maps, fixing bugs and introducing new features.

One of the requests was to illuminate the night. We opted to not add a simple flashlight and instead added a new tool, the Flare Pistol. Available by default, starting with 2 rounds, can be refilled at Ammo stations to a maximum of 5 rounds.

[previewyoutube=4CliQ39Z2Mo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: United Assault - World War 2 Early Access Content overview
notes.content:
Soldiers,

United Assault - World War 2 is releasing in Early Access next week. Today we take a closer look at the content you can expect at launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213481/60afadb2d6ad07c68b712492dbf7577077edbd3e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Maps and playable Factions at Early Access Start[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pacific - Midway[/b] (playing as US Marines)
[*] [b]Eastern Fornt - Stalingrad[/b] (playing as Wehrmacht) - unlocked at Rank 10
[/list]
North Africa - Tobruk and Italy - Regusa will unlock over the duration of Early Access.

[h2][b]Maximum reachable rank[/b][/h2]
[b]37[/b] (450000 XP), this will increate to Rank 100 over the duration of Early Access.

[h2][b]Weapons in order of Unlock at Early Access Start[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Type 14
[*] M 1911
[*] Type 100
[*] BAR
[*] M1 Carbine
[*] Type 99
[*] Thompson
[*] M1 Garand
[*] Type 99 Sniper
[*] P38
[*] MP 40
[*] Mosin Nagant
[*] DP-28
[*] G 43
[*] Mosin Nagant Sniper
[*] PPSH 41
[*] SVT
[*] Volkssturmgewehr
[*] SVT Sniper
[*] PTRS-41
[/list]
Additional 25 Weapons will be added/unlocked over the duration of Early Access

[h2][b]Advanced Loot[/b][/h2]
Weapons can now be looted and exist in 5 degrees of rarity. Rarity is defined by the number of weapon modifications (in mechanic, there won't be visible attachements). Those modifications are randomly selected and can modify the damage, rate of fire, recoil and ammo capacity. A looted weapon can only be used in the session it was looted in.

If you dislike this variation of loot, you can simply distable it in the settings menu.
